summary.text: Matthew Arndt is the Green Party nominee for Wisconsin's 6th District. He describes himself as a CPA and small-business owner who runs a tax and investment advisory firm and grew up in Green Bay. He has not held elected office.

paragraphs.text: Arndt says he grew up in Green Bay, Wisconsin, with nine siblings; his father was a construction worker and his mother a nurse.

He describes himself as a CPA who runs a tax and investment advisory firm working with business owners and families, and says he is a husband and the father of two young children and not a career politician.
He advanced from the Green Party primary on August 11, 2026, receiving 62 votes in an uncontested race.
